claims_not_permitted: 15 seconds replaces the existing 30-second M-PV2 contract

limitations.detail: D0 VAL and D0_SUBJECT_HELDOUT were not used; D0 accuracy is not held-out evidence.
D1_DEV_VAL contains PRESENT and AMBIGUOUS rows but no supervised ABSENT rows; D1 absent recall and macro F1 are undefined.
AMBIGUOUS rows remain provenance/transition evidence and are not converted into a pure class.
Gap/freeze/stale recovery is a Q2 quality-only synthetic timing diagnostic, not real MR60 or Pi measurement.
RR is metadata-only because a 15-second context may contain too few cycles at low rates.
Temporal hold/history is excluded from this candidate.
No INT8/TFLite conversion, Raspberry Pi latency, or real-sensor validation was performed.
Inherited A4 reference semantics are SafeNest breathing proxies and are not clinical apnea.
